known_outcome: Determination (7 Dec 2023, s 188): the driveway, retaining wall and timber vehicle deck comply with B1 and B2 (p.39 §7.1.1); the timber vehicle deck and barrier comply with C3 to the extent required by the Act (p.40 §7.1.2); the authority was incorrect to grant consent BCN/2015/2452 and its third amendment for work on the neighbouring property, but the Chief Executive elected not to reverse or confirm those decisions (p.40 §7.1.3-7.1.4); the code compliance certificate was reversed (p.40 §7.1.5); the authority did not fail to issue a notice to fix (p.40 §7.1.6). Reasoning: C3.4-C3.9 do not apply to the deck and barrier (p.29 Table 1); C/AS1 §5.5 carport conditions are not met (p.30); C/AS1 §5.1.1 concerns external walls (p.30-31). Clarified under s 189 (p.1 fn 1).
review_focus: Whether the answer identifies C3.3 as the functional test and separates encroachment from fire spread generally.
Whether it notes that an acceptable solution is one means of compliance and that the acceptable-solution conditions must be checked.
Whether it flags missing C1-C6 means-of-compliance documents on consent and CCC records.
Whether it separates the building-work compliance question from the consent-decision and CCC questions.
Whether it avoids stating that the work is safe or compliant.
